body.en: The call rests on these placements, not on a general stanza:
body.hi: निर्णय सामान्य श्लोक पर नहीं, इन स्थितियों पर टिका है:

citations.en: Venus in the 2nd (Taurus) — in its own sign, self-contained but slow to move.

citations.en: Saturn in the 9th (Sagittarius), retrograde — the result arrives in re-runs.
citations.hi: शनि नवम भाव (धनु) में, वक्री — फल दोबारा आता है।

closing_question.en: Say the one thing you want tightened and I will take it alone.
